analysis.rationale: No compression (block_boundary 0.9996/1.009/0.997, unique_G 233/237/243; unchanged in R1 re-run of full_analysis on pair0). Blur_gaussian:3 confirmed: peak of the PSNR bracket over {2,3,4,5} on all 3 pairs (sev2 26.78/22.42/21.82; sev4/5 previously WEAK in R0 signal tests; anisotropy 1.148 < 1.7 excludes motion; glass rule not applicable at sigma>3; lens MTF-indistinguishable and failed noise-sigma when tested). Global = saturate_strengthen_HSV, severity 4 -> 3: R0 only bracketed severity upward (sat5: 27.44/21.59/20.81) and R0's own final_decision noted sim sat4 over-darkens pairs1/2 by ~5 gray levels ('consistent with severity slightly above truth'); the untested lower severity 3 improves simulation PSNR on all 3 pairs (27.91/23.69/23.18 vs sat4 27.69/22.69/21.91). HSV severity scale is [3,6,12,20,64] (sev3=12x, sev4=20x): the two differ mainly on low-saturation pixels, so sev3 is physically plausible (verdict kept UNCERTAIN because the 3-pair PSNR stays below 40 dB). Noise step removed: noise exists only as UNCERTAIN in R0 (type unidentifiable under the confirmed noise->blur order, SKILL 54.7% ~ random); the peeled residual is spatially structured (spatial_corr 0.9869 with sat4 peel, 0.9864 with sat3 peel, residual_std 10.2), not noise-like; per-pair noise_prior sigma is inconsistent under the identical GT pipeline (3.83/1.11/0.49; pairs1/2 at or below the SKILL sigma<2 NO_NOISE threshold) and residual_intensity_corr=0.864 shows the pair0 residual is intensity-dependent (saturation clamp). Adding speckle:3 raised the simulation error beyond seed-mismatch expectation on all 3 pairs (extra RMS ~6/10/10 vs target sigma ~3.8/1.1/0.5), so the injected noise is mis-modelled. Change threshold: deterministic candidates need >40 dB or +2 dB vs the previous round; the winning candidate clears +2 dB on the majority of support pairs (pair1 +2.15, pair2 +2.20) and improves every pair (pair0 +1.46, mean +1.94), addressed with the same majority-of-pairs semantics the protocol specifies for k>1 noise comparisons.
